what: The cut: from 150 m before its split at 15 m/s, the autopilot takes it (sim seed 1). After 1500 ticks it is about 100 m of road further on than the car that went round, and it slides on the dirt (more slip than the road allows). br-4tbo (2026-10-18): the autopilot plans to the car's own pace and turn and brakes on a curve, so it takes the cut faster and cleaner: 390 m (was 260-320), slip 5.2 degrees (min 8 -> 4.5).
